testModificationPermission.note: YES, only when required in a later implementation phase; preserve meaningful assertions and do not weaken tests merely to make them pass.

gaps.title: No CI workflow to build/lint/test backend + frontend
gaps.description: No .github/workflows/ directory detected in root listing;

gaps.title: No containerization for running full stack
gaps.description: No Dockerfile or docker-compose files evidenced in root listing; app is run manually via separate backend/frontend commands.

gaps.title: No frontend automated tests configured
gaps.description: frontend/package.json has dev/build/lint/preview but no test script or test dependencies (e.g., vitest/jest/playwright).

gaps.title: Missing integration-test coverage for persistence layer
gaps.description: Backend tests include a context smoke test and a @WebMvcTest controller test with mocked TodoService (backend/src/test/java/../TodoControllerTest.java);

gaps.title: No machine-readable API contract (OpenAPI/Swagger)
gaps.description: backend/pom.xml does not include an OpenAPI/Swagger generation dependency (e.g., springdoc); instead there is only a human-readable API section in README.md.

gaps.title: No authentication/authorization protecting API
gaps.description: No Spring Security dependency evidenced in backend/pom.xml; the TodoController provides public CRUD endpoints under /api/todos.

gaps.title: CORS policy not explicitly defined for non-dev usage
gaps.description: frontend/vite.config.ts uses a dev proxy for /api to http://localhost:8080; no backend CORS config was evidenced among the inspected backend config package (config/ contains only DataSourceInitializer.), so cross-origin behavior outside dev proxy is unclear.

gaps.title: Config not parameterized (DB URL, port, profiles)
gaps.description: backend/src/main/resources/application.yml hardcodes jsri:csqlite:./data/todo.db and server.port:8080; no profile-specific YAML or env var documentation evidenced.

gaps.title: No documented seed/reset data lifecycle for dev/test
gaps.description: Flyway migration exists (backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/V1__create_todos_table.sql) and runtime creates ./data directory (DataSourceInitializer.), but no seeding scripts, test fixtures, or reset tooling/docs were evidenced.

gaps.title: No health/metrics endpoints (Actuator)
gaps.description: No spring-boot-starter-actuator dependency evidenced in backend/pom.xml; no health endpoint docs config enidenced.

gaps.title: Limited developer documentation beyond basic run steps
gaps.description: Root README.md provides basic run instructions and an API table; no deticated docs/ tree was evidenced in root listing (pre-handoff).

gaps.title: No root-level unified workflow (one-command build/test/run)
gaps.description: Backend and frontend are separate (Maven in backend/, npm in frontend/) and no root-scoped scripts/tooling were evidenced to unify build/test/run.
